subject: SIG questionnaire: outstanding artifacts and security deck
messages:
From: Lucas Brennan <lucas.brennan@clearlinehealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearlinehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: final items for evaluation

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for walking us through the platform yesterday. Our security team is finishing the SIG questionnaire and has flagged a few outstanding artifacts we still need to complete their review:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Penetration test executive summary (redacted is fine)
- ISO 27001 statement of applicability or certificate (if available)
- Security/product deck that covers architecture, data flows, and controls (PDF)

Can you confirm if you can provide these documents and an estimated delivery time? We need the pen test summary within the next 72 hours if possible.

Also, if there are any pages in your internal compliance site we can browse (read-only), that would help speed things up.

Best,
Lucas
Security Program Manager
Clearline Health

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Brennan <lucas.brennan@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: final items for evaluation

Hi Lucas — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Monica from our security team and Karthik on the account.

Initial answers / plan:
- SOC 2 Type II (2025) — we have the report, will attach the PDF and a short cover note.
- Pen test summary — we have a redacted executive summary; currently awaiting final QA from the vendor. Monica, can we get the redacted summary signed off today?
- ISO 27001 — we do not have a certificate but we have an internal statement of controls and our most recent gap assessment; sharing a short statement instead.
- Security deck — we have v3 of our external-facing security deck; will confirm the latest PDF.

Action items: 
1) Monica: confirm pen test redaction status and ETA (today/Tomorrow).
2) Monica: attach SOC2 and security deck if available.
3) Sofia/Karthik: provide a short cover email that lists what is included and any access links.

Happy to schedule a quick follow-up call if that helps.

— Sofia
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-22T08:27:00-07:00

Hi all — status update: 

- SOC2: attached (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf). This is the latest Type II report for our hosted offering; happy to redact any client references if you need us to.
- Pen test: vendor delivered an executive summary this morning. We are redacting specific IPs and low-level exploit traces; attached is the redacted executive summary (pen_test_summary_q1_2026_redacted.pdf).
- ISO: we do not hold ISO 27001 certification; attached is our controls statement and a brief note on our roadmap toward certification (controls_statement_2026.txt).
- Security deck: attached (redwood_security_deck_v3.pdf). This deck includes architecture diagrams, data flow, and control mappings.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (PDF, 8.4MB) — pen_test_summary_q1_2026_redacted.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — redwood_security_deck_v3.pdf (PDF, 4.1MB)

Lucas — if you want a short walkthrough of deck sections or a recorded tour, I can record a 10-minute screen share.

Monica Patel
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lucas Brennan <lucas.brennan@clearlinehealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-22T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: final items for evaluation

Thanks Monica — that looks great. A few quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm that the pen test summary excludes customer-identifying data? Looks OK at first glance but our legal team insists on confirmation before we attach it to the SIG answers.
2) Can you add a one-paragraph blurb we can paste into the SIG about how you handle vulnerability management cadence (triage, SLA to remediation, and patching windows)?
3) We received an NDA to sign; would you prefer we use DocuSign (we can trigger) or upload signed copy to your portal?

If you can send the confirmation and the vulnerability-management blurb, we should be able to close the SIG today.

— Lucas

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: final items for evaluation — artifacts and statements provided

Hi Lucas — following up with the confirmations and the short blurb you requested. Apologies for the delayed reply; Monica and I reviewed the redacted items.

1) Pen test redaction confirmation: Monica confirms the attached pen_test_summary_q1_2026_redacted.pdf contains no customer-identifying data or internal IPs. Redaction checklist: customer names removed, full exploit payloads truncated, internal hostnames hashed.

2) Vulnerability management blurb (paste-friendly):
"Redwood maintains a continuous vulnerability management program. Incoming findings are triaged within 24 hours; critical findings are escalated immediately with a target remediation SLA of 30 days and ongoing compensating controls where immediate remediation is not possible. Monthly patch windows are scheduled for non-critical updates with emergency patching for critical CVEs. Third-party components are scanned weekly and re-assessed during major releases."

3) NDA / signing: We can accept DocuSign. I’ve uploaded the finalized NDA to DocuSign and shared a link below — you should have an email from DocuSign. If you prefer to upload a signed PDF to our portal, reply and we’ll provide the upload link.
